GeneChip analysis.readouts: gene expression levels measured on Affymetrix GeneChips

evidence.section: Preparation of samples for GeneChip analysis
evidence.quote: Preparation of cellular RNA and subsequent processing for GeneChip analysis were performed as described elsewhere [28], by use of the HG-U133 A 2.0 and HG-U133 Plus 2.0 GeneChips (Affymetrix)

Real-time polymerase chain reaction.readouts: fluorescence-based detection and fold changes of PSME2, PSMB9, PSMB6, and PSMA4 gene expression

evidence.quote: TaqMan Gene Expression Assays (Applied Biosystems) were used to detect genes in the immunoproteosome pathway (PSME2, PSMB9, PSMB6, and PSMA4) in 3 randomly chosen samples from protected and nonprotected persons, at 2 weeks after the third vaccination.

malaria thick blood smears.readouts: detection of malaria parasites and parasitemia status

evidence.quote: Infection with malaria was determined by detection of parasite in malaria thick blood smears during the 30 days after challenge.
